title: Antenna Lead/Sr.Lead
minimumQualification: - Bachelor’s, Master’s, RF, Microwave, Communications Engineering, or a related field.
jobDescription:
An Antenna Engineer is a specialized professional responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining antennas used in a wide range of communication systems which includes Telecommunications with 4G and 5G NR, broadcasting technologies.
 Key Responsibilities :
- Strong understanding of electromagnetic theory, wave propagation, and antenna theory.
- Design and prototype antennas for various communication systems, ensuring they meet the performance requirements for range, frequency, and sensitivity.
- Use simulation software (such as CST, HFSS, or ADS) to model and test antenna performance before physical prototypes are built.
- Knowledge of RF testing equipment (e.g., Network analyzers, Spectrum analyzers).
- Familiarity with materials and technologies used in antenna design, such as microstrip antennas, phased arrays, and radomes.
- Conduct rigorous testing of antenna prototypes and final designs in lab, field environments including anechoic chambers.
- Evaluate antenna performance in various real-world environments, accounting for variables such as interference, signal attenuation, and multipath effects.
- Optimize antenna arrays and configurations to ensure consistent performance in complex environments.
- Work closely with electrical engineers, RF (Radio Frequency) engineers, and system engineers to integrate antennas into larger communication systems.
- Work closely with inter disciplinary team (Mechanical, CAD, etc)
- Document designs, testing procedures, and results to maintain a clear record of development and modifications.
- Ensure all antennas comply with industry standards and regulations for safety, performance, and reliability.
- Work with manufacturing teams to ensure that antenna designs are produced to the required quality specifications.
- Experience in specific antenna types like array antennas, MIMO (Multiple Input, Multiple Output), or directional antennas.
- Familiarity with software-defined radio (SDR) and its application in antenna systems
- In some industries (e.g., aerospace or defense), travel to customer sites or remote locations may be required.
 Qualifications and Experience:
 Educational Background:
- Bachelor’s, Master’s, RF, Microwave, Communications Engineering, or a related field.
 Experience:
- Minimum 5-8 years’ experience in antenna design or relevant fields
- Experience with antenna design and development in industries such as telecommunications,
- aerospace, or defense.
- Previous experience working with wireless communication standards (e.g., 3GPP, Wi-Fi, MilStd).
 Soft Skills:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
- Attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot and refine designs. Apply via the official Lekha Wireless careers page.

title: RF Firmware Engineer/Sr. Engineer/Lead
minimumQualification: A graduate/ Postgraduate in Electronics/ Electrical/ Instrumentation or related disciplines experience in design and development of Wireless systems involving these high-speed transceivers and front ends
jobDescription:
What will you do:
 You will be part of an energetic team working of next generation and present-day problems in the world of Wireless communication in the areas of Tactical communication, 4G and 5G.
You will be responsible for RF Firmware bring-up, configuration, development of testing around RF transceivers (Analog Devices AD9361, AD9375, ADRV9026/9, ADRV9002, TI DAC’s and ADC’s, Xilinx RFSoC).
You will work on signal chain implementation on variety of wireless communication products, build cores and interfaces that enable high speed data paths and provide technical leadership in challenging design flows.
 Education:
A graduate/ Postgraduate in Electronics/ Electrical/ Instrumentation or related disciplines experience in design and development of Wireless systems involving these high-speed transceivers and front ends
 Required Skills:
- Being proficient in C/Matlab.
- Possess good understanding of ADC/ DAC and Transceiver architectures and signal chains.
- Be proficient in signal processing - analyzing signal captures, deep understanding of dynamic range issues, AGC, DPD, CFR.
- Be proficient in implementation flow of one or more data link products.
- Be proficient in understanding of general DSP architecture, FPGA interfaces such as JESD, 10G Ethernet etc….
- Be proficient in understanding hardware and embedded interfaces for bringup.
- Possess ability to clearly interact with Hardware, and embedded functions.

 Good to have:
